name: Red Lentil Tomato Soup
ingredients: ½ cup (100 g) red lentils (masoor dal), rinsed
steps: Boil the lentils, tomatoes, turmeric and water for 15 minutes until soft.
Blend until smooth and return to the pot.
In a small pan heat the oil, crackle the cumin, then cook onion, garlic and ginger for 5 minutes.
Stir the tempering into the soup and simmer for 5 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper and top with coriander.
note: Indian-spiced and tempered, unlike the smoky roasted version (see Roasted Tomato Lentil Soup).
